Ane Mintegi del Olmo (born 24 October 2003) is a Spanish tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) of 377, achieved on 7 February 2022. [ 1 ] Mintegi won the girls' singles title at the 2021 Wimbledon Championships .
